title: Canvas Pick Disambiguation
description: Unified canvas pick disambiguation: shared protocol, DOM pick menu, multi-hit resolvers across draw/raster/flow/puzzle/writer/cad, transitive hover focus.
summary: Implemented unified canvas pick disambiguation across all canvas apps: shared CanvasPickTarget protocol and CanvasHoverFocusStore in framework/core; CanvasPickMenu + useCanvasPickInteraction in ui/react; multi-hit resolvers and pick-menu wiring for draw, raster, flow, puzzle2d, writer, puzzle3d, and CAD; WASM pickTargetsAtScreenJson for graph/flow/puzzle2d/writer; playground draw/raster hosts use AppPointerFocusStore source arbitration for canvas vs hierarchy hover.
